title: MySQL
description:
MySQL / MariaDB: a recursive CTE, `information_schema` and `SHOW` statements. Needs
`make it-up` (port 13306). See `:help dbdash-databases`.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE h(n) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM h WHERE n < 23)
SELECT LPAD(n, 2, '0') AS hour, FLOOR(50 + 30 * SIN(n / 4) + RAND() * 20) AS orders
FROM h

show.title: Orders per hour (recursive CTE)
show.description: Orders per hour of a day, made by a recursive CTE.

query.sql:
SELECT table_schema AS db, COUNT(*) AS tables, SUM(table_rows) AS approx_rows
FROM information_schema.tables
GROUP BY table_schema ORDER BY tables DESC

show.title: Tables per schema (information_schema)
show.description: Tables and approximate rows per schema from `information_schema.tables`.

query.sql:
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN
  ('Threads_connected', 'Uptime', 'Questions', 'Bytes_received', 'Bytes_sent')

show.title: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS
show.description:
A few server counters from `SHOW GLOBAL STATUS` (a SHOW statement works like a
query).
